bio_text: Jamie Cerexhe is the Co-Founder and CTO of Mastt, an agentic AI platform for construction project management that he co-launched in 2019 and has grown to support 500+ projects worth over AU$25 billion. A Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia honoree (Enterprise Technology, 2021) and PMI Future 50 awardee (2022), Jamie leads a global engineering team with a strong conviction that AI agents should handle repetitive project delivery work so humans can focus on higher-order decisions. Before Mastt, he held senior roles at Contentserv, ran coding bootcamps at Coder Academy, and contributed digital skills programs for the United Nations.
